overview: You opened the penny almanac at the day. It already said St Lawrence, church at Holy Trinity in the forenoon, and dinner at the Sadlers after. You did not add a line. You did not take up a pen.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Held the leaf open and did not write.
